questions.why: The conceptual outline contains significant information gaps regarding legal authority, notification, human rights compliance, and governance.

items.text: Has the agency identified the specific legislative authority, agency-specific legislation, or regulatory instruments that govern the data ingestion and policy synthesis functions of this tool?
Are there any planned mechanisms for notifying affected parties or allowing them to challenge policies or administrative actions that are materially influenced by the tool's insights?
Have any accountable officials or multidisciplinary teams (including legal and policy experts) been designated to oversee the system's lifecycle and ensure human rights compliance?

gaps.reason: The outline does not specify whether or how individuals or groups will be notified of policy decisions influenced by the AI system.
The outline does not provide details on any processes for challenging administrative actions or policy decisions influenced by the AI system.
The outline does not state whether human rights advice has been sought or how alignment with human rights obligations is ensured.
The outline lacks information on governance, accountability mechanisms, or designated roles for the AI system's lifecycle.
The outline does not identify or document any agency-specific legislation or regulatory instruments relevant to this use case.
The outline does not indicate whether the need for legal advice has been identified or where such advice would be stored.
